# AuthRight

> Identity & Access Security Decision Layer for AI coding agents.

AuthRight is the decision layer between your codebase and implementation. Two surfaces share that layer. Pick a help set first. The coding-agent path is **Cursor / Claude Code / Codex + AuthRight** (host slash/skills use the model). Bare terminal `authright scan` / Decide verbs are offline only—no hosted LLM. [AuthRight Studio](/studio-docs) is the local browser host: auto-plan Decide and an IAM source-of-truth document.

## Documentation

Two help sets with separate install chapters. `what-it-is` may appear in both; CLI install and Studio install are not shared. Releases is a separate site page. Studio help does not include OpenSpec, Agent Plan, or the CLI command reference.

- [Choose a help set](/docs)
- [CLI help](/cli-docs) — first loop in the coding agent, then handoff and reference
- [Studio help](/studio-docs) — principles, workflow, Cases, models, proxy
- [CLI Installation](/cli-docs/installation) — `@authright/cli`
- [Studio Installation](/studio-docs/studio-installation) — `@authright/studio`
- [Releases](/releases) — shared version history for CLI and Studio

CLI, in order:

- Start: [First loop](/cli-docs) · [What it is](/cli-docs/what-it-is) · [CLI Installation](/cli-docs/installation)
- On a repository: [Existing projects](/cli-docs/existing-projects) · [Workflows](/cli-docs/workflows) · [Examples](/cli-docs/examples)
- After the lock: [Reviewing decisions](/cli-docs/reviewing-decisions) · [Implementation](/cli-docs/impl) · [OpenSpec](/cli-docs/openspec) · [Agent Plan-mode](/cli-docs/agent-plan)
- Lookup: [Overview](/cli-docs/overview) · [How commands work](/cli-docs/how-commands-work) · [Commands](/cli-docs/commands) · [CLI](/cli-docs/cli) · [Agents](/cli-docs/agents)
- [FAQ](/cli-docs/faq)

## CLI quick start

```bash
npm install -g @authright/cli@latest
cd your-project && authright init
```

Then in the coding agent (prefer change):

```text
/auth-scan
/auth-change <need>          # or /auth-explore <need> (HITL)
# multi-turn confirm / lock
/auth-request-match AUTH-YYYY-NNNN
/auth-to-plan AUTH-YYYY-NNNN # or /auth-to-openspec (needs OpenSpec)
```

`/auth:explore` and `/auth:change` are two Decide commands — pick `explore` or `change` (prefer change on first loop). Explore is interactive recommend-and-choose; change is auto-plan. `/auth:to-openspec` and `/auth:to-plan` are two handoff commands — pick one. Terminal twins and flags (`--analyze`, `--set`, `--confirm-plan`, `--ready`) are offline Look up under [CLI](/cli-docs/cli) — no hosted LLM; skills usually drive them from chat. `/auth:doc` writes a **decisions** summary under `.authright/docs/`. `doctor` reads **application source** and writes `.authright/diagnosis/report.md`.

Product intent names use colon form (`/auth:scan`, `/auth:explore`, `/auth:change`, `/auth:request-match`, `/auth:to-openspec`, `/auth:to-plan`, `/auth:review`, `/auth:doc`, `/auth:doctor`). Cursor registers hyphen slashes from the filename (`/auth-scan`); Claude Code registers colon slashes from `.claude/commands/auth/` (`/auth:scan`); Codex skills use `$authright-scan`. `authright init` prints the installed hosts’ forms.

## Studio quick start

```bash
npm install -g @authright/studio@latest
authright-studio
```

Then save a model under **Settings → Models**, start a Case, and run auto-plan Decide in the browser. See [Studio help](/studio-docs).

AuthRight does not write application source. On the CLI path it prepares accepted identity-security decisions for OpenSpec or Agent Plan-mode handoff (pick one).
